description: Every Velar P300 is different. That's why we offer the right solution for your engine, your car and your budget.

cards.title: REBUILDING YOUR Velar P300 ENGINE
cards.body: We rebuild the engine your Velar P300 already has instead of selling you a used engine of unknown history — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component (timing chains, bearings, water pump, gaskets) with updated OEM parts. Near-new performance with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: RECONDITIONED Velar P300 ENGINES
cards.body: A full strip-down, inspection and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.

cards.title: REFURBISHED Velar P300 ENGINES
cards.body: Restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild service covers this.

cards.title: REMANUFACTURED Velar P300 ENGINES
cards.body: Built to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers on the engine.

cards.title: REPLACEMENT Velar P300 ENGINES
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we offer complete engine replacement and fitting – sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month warranty.

cards.title: USED Velar P300 ENGINES
cards.body: Matched low-mileage used engines for when time is critical. We source and fit these too, but most owners choose a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risks.

banner.title: NOT SURE WHICH OPTION IS RIGHT FOR YOU?
banner.body: Enter your registration below and we'll confirm your engine and talk you through the best solution for your Velar P300, honestly.
